subject.title: chore(deps): bump the swift-deps group across 1 directory with 4 updates

question: Should this grouped macOS dependency update merge after refreshed focused CI, or must the final head also pass signed-app smoke for Sparkle and Peekaboo?
rationale: Source compatibility and security guards are positive, but deciding whether they sufficiently cover the packaged updater and privileged automation boundaries requires macOS owner risk acceptance.

options.title: Smoke Then Merge
options.body: Refresh the branch and verify Sparkle updater availability plus Peekaboo bridge startup in a correctly signed macOS app.

options.title: Accept Focused CI
options.body: Merge after the final head passes focused macOS and security checks, explicitly accepting the remaining packaged-runtime uncertainty.

options.title: Split Runtime Pins
options.body: Pause the grouped PR and request independent Peekaboo and Sparkle updates for smaller validation and rollback units.

recommendation.title: Smoke Then Merge
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and verify Sparkle updater availability plus Peekaboo bridge startup in a correctly signed macOS app.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current bridge boundary, owns the upstream Peekaboo release, and has the strongest recent history across both affected runtime paths.
